department: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
responsibilities: Formulating the overarching framework for digital transformation of MoSPI, including modernization of IT architecture.
Providing technical inputs and advice on hardware, software and technology stack specifications and on conceptualizing and planning divisional projects.
Coordinating with other divisions on digital initiatives.
Providing guidelines and policy input on cyber security and related issues.
Design, development, updation and maintenance of the Ministry's website.
Maintenance and updation of e-Sankhyiki Portal and CPI Portal.
Dissemination of microdata of surveys and census conducted by the Ministry.
Implementation of the Data Innovation-Lab component of the Capacity Development Scheme.
Facilitating NIC Cloud Services for hosting and maintenance of Ministry applications and portals.
Publication of the Compendium of Datasets and Registries.
source_document: Compendium of Roles and Responsibilities of Divisions / Units of MoSPI
